name: reply-media
description: Draws the mermaid fences, math formulas and local images of a reply as pictures in the terminal, and plays its local videos (kitty graphics: Ghostty, kitty)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.description: Draw a ```mermaid fence as a picture. Off, the fence stays text, and Claude is not told to draw diagrams that way.

math.title: Formulas
math.description: Draw a ```math fence or a $$ block as a picture. Off, the formula stays text, and Claude is not told to write formulas that way.

images.title: Images
images.description: Draw a local image written as ![alt](path) on a line of its own. Off, the line stays text, and Claude is not told to show images that way.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Show a local video written as ![alt](path) as its first frame with a play button. Off, the line stays text, and Claude is not told to show videos that way.

buttons.title: Buttons under a picture
buttons.description: Copy a picture's source (an image's path), and zoom it in a pane, or open a video in the player. A video's play button stays.

resumedReplies.title: Replies redrawn on resume
resumedReplies.description: How many of a resumed session's last replies get their pictures drawn again. Each picture is rendered before the first prompt, so a higher number starts slower. 0 redraws none.

pxPerColumn.title: Picture pixels per column
pxPerColumn.description: How many pixels of a picture one terminal column shows. A lower number draws pictures larger.

cellAspect.title: Cell height over width
cellAspect.description: How many times taller than wide one terminal cell is. Change it when pictures look squashed or stretched. 2.17 was measured on Ghostty with JetBrains Mono 18.
